senses.definition: The general mood and ideas that define a particular period of time.
senses.caution: A German loanword, so it can sound grand. Use it for a broad cultural mood, not for one trend or one news story.
senses.example: The film caught the zeitgeist of 2020, when everyone was working from home and feeling uncertain.

cues.text: A marketing lead says the campaign works because it matches what people are feeling and talking about this year. What borrowed word names that shared mood of the age?
Historians look back at the 1960s and describe the shared attitudes and ideas that defined the decade. What German word do they use?
A critic says a novel captured how a whole generation was thinking and feeling when it came out. You want the German word for the mood of an age.

distractors: A feeling of great sadness, with no hope that things will get better.
A group of people who have spread out far from the place they came from.
A sudden change that is large and lasts for many years.
The most senior people in a company or a group.
A place where everyone can be watched at once.
